test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest rate = R × T

⇒ Effective rate = 9% × 4 = 36%

Simple Interest = 36% of Principal

⇒ SI = (36 ÷ 100) × 2500 = 36 × 25 = 900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate (R) = 9% per annum

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90e2b558074dbf49d76c8cdbbf9186c13008d4b4a50760aefc68ba71638f8466.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (2500 × 9 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 2500 × 36 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 25 × 36

⇒ SI = 900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Amount Formula

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest = P × (1 + RT ÷ 100)

Compound Interest (CI)

When interest is compounded annually, Amount = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)T. CI = Amount − Principal.

Difference between CI and SI (for 2 years)

Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)². This trick is extremely useful in direct competitive exam questions.
